subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should restart-drain bypass capability stay private to core-owned shutdown code, or may it be exposed through the public plugin SDK as enqueueInternal/allowDuringGatewayDrain?
rationale: Plugin SDK changes and gateway-drain bypasses are compatibility and security-boundary decisions; the code can be repaired mechanically only if maintainers agree the bypass should remain internal.

options.title: Keep Bypass Internal
options.body: Remove the public SDK-facing bypass and route restart flushing through a private core-owned drain context with focused tests.

options.title: Approve Public SDK Bypass
options.body: Treat enqueueInternal and drain-bypass flags as intentional plugin API, then document the contract and add compatibility/security tests before merge.

options.title: Pause For Persistence Design
options.body: Hold this PR while the broader restart-message-loss work in the canonical queue persistence cluster decides the durable owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Bypass Internal
recommendation.body: Remove the public SDK-facing bypass and route restart flushing through a private core-owned drain context with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant queue and command-drain history points to steipete as the strongest owner for the shutdown semantics and security-boundary decision.
